setupIntro: Notes and images are saved on this computer and synced to a private notebook in your own GitHub account. Cloud data is private by default and is not stored on the plugin author's servers.

setupLoginWaiting: Finish verification on GitHub. One-time code

setupOfflineHint: Internet access is needed for first-time setup. Afterwards, you can edit and save offline; sync resumes automatically when the connection returns.
setupToolsHint: The plugin uses these tools automatically. You do not need to learn or enter commands.
setupGhHint: Signs in to GitHub and authorizes access to your notebook.
setupInstallHint: Install any missing tools, then click Check again. If they still appear missing, fully quit and reopen DSH.
setupInstallHelp: How do I install these tools?
setupInstallSteps:
Use the installation link next to a missing tool to open its official website.
Windows: download the installer for your computer and use its default options.
macOS: follow the official installation guide; this plugin has not been tested on a Mac yet.
Return here and check again. You do not need to configure a Git repository or enter sync commands.
setupLoginNeedsTool: Install GitHub CLI and check again to sign in here.

setupExistingHint: Choose this on another computer or to restore notes. Enter the name of a notebook previously created by Fatfish Notes in the same account.
